notes: Normalized against the fixed prepared PhapDien snapshot; no claim of current legal validity or independent expert approval.
All 45 records are development because prior results were inspected. A new untouched test set is still required.
No unanswerable cases were added and no pipeline inference or judge calls were run during normalization.
Question wording is preserved unless scope/reference alignment requires clarification. No blanket insertion of titles or retrieval hints.
Reference claims are separately assessable legal propositions. A definition or a closed list under one predicate can remain one claim; attached conditions and exceptions are preserved.

Evidence quotes are contiguous verbatim spans of original evidence, checked by the existing resolver against all leaf chunks in the corpus. Relevance remains quote-based and is not an exhaustive relevance judgment over alternative provisions.
PhapDien article identifiers are retained; original-law article numbers and legal effective versions are not guessed.
The three multi_document items require synthesizing two cited documents but do not by themselves prove graph traversal or multi-hop reasoning.
Changed labels/question wording require a fresh run directory. Do not merge or directly interpret score differences as pipeline improvements against the old run.
